title: Dissolved oxygen through a lake
bodyMd:
A field team sampled a lake at noon on one calm day. At each depth, the team measured temperature and dissolved oxygen with calibrated probes. Light reaching a depth was reported as a percentage of surface light measured at the same time. All readings below are means of three samples; they are invented practice data. The table describes a single profile and does not establish the lake's conditions throughout the year.

| Depth (m) | Temperature (degrees C) | Dissolved oxygen (mg/L) | Surface light remaining (%) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|0|24|8.0|100|
|2|23|7.8|60|
|4|21|7.2|36|
|6|16|5.0|22|
|8|12|2.0|13|
|10|11|1.0|8|

For questions requesting interpolation, assume a straight-line change between the nearest sampled depths. Do not assume the same rate continues beyond the measured range.
